name: How do I determine the right dimensions for a banquette to fit my space?
description: Measure your space accurately, considering seat depth (18-24 inches), height (18-19 inches), and clearance, along with architectural features.

mainEntity.name: How do I determine the right dimensions for a banquette to fit my space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Determining the right dimensions for a banquette involves carefully measuring your available space and considering the intended number of users and clearance for movement. Standard seat depth is typically 18-24 inches, and seat height around 18-19 inches. When measuring, factor in any existing architectural features like windows, doorways, or heating vents, as these will define the maximum length and height constraints for your custom build.
